## Announcements

### New dinosaur identified by Museum Paleontologists!

![Image 10](https://www.nmnaturalhistory.org/sites/default/files/Dinevenator%20by%20Sergey%20Krasovskiy_WEB%20version.jpg)

Exciting news: Paleontologists from the New Mexico Museum of Natural History & Science have identified a new genus of two-legged dinosaur that lived in New Mexico more than 70 million years ago!

Introducing _Dinevenator robustus_. Dinevenator was a troodontid, a family of bird-like dinosaurs known for having unusually large brains relative to other dinosaurs. Scientists believe Dinevenator was approximately 8 to 10 feet in body length and weighed between 150 to 300 pounds, making it one of the larger troodontids known.(Artwork by Sergey Krasovskiy)

### Free admission for Valencia County residents in August & September!

![Image 11](https://www.nmnaturalhistory.org/sites/default/files/Valencia%20County%20Free%20Days%20Sponsored%20by%20Meta%202026%20Flyer.jpg)

Exciting news: sponsored museum attendance for Valencia County residents is returning soon, courtesy of Meta!

**Throughout September** and during a special preview on **August 1-2**, Valencia County residents and Isleta Pueblo members can enjoy the museum free of charge! Eligible residents should bring a driver's license or any other proof of residency to the Museum's front desk to participate during either of those periods. This includes free museum admission and entry to a show at our Planetarium.

### We’ve evolved! Our Museum will reopen on April 4

![Image 12](https://www.nmnaturalhistory.org/sites/default/files/NMMNHS_Aerial.jpg)

It’s the news you’ve all been waiting for: our museum is reopening to the public on _**Saturday, April 4**_! Enjoy new features like our r edesigned box office and our expanded gift shop, alo ngside familiar favorites like t he Evolator and Bella, our roaring animatronic Bisti Beast.

We’ll be hosting a celebration at the museum on the big day, and you’re all invited! Starting at 10:00 a.m., enjoy a block party, ribbon-cutting ceremony, and a chance to explore the museum’s new amenities and familiar attractions. Shows at the Planetarium, Powered by Meta and the Verus Research DynaTheater will be included with museum admission throughout the weekend.We can't wait to show off all of our new features and familiar favorites!
